rule: After production, lead-loss, incorrect-data and broken-user-journey emergencies, finish the approved Search3 design across the site, publish a coherent preview, verify the user journey and prepare a reversible migration. Production draft #1334 must not merge or deploy until explicit owner visual approval of the concrete release. Preview publishing and draft preparation are authorized. Preserve AnyTour Design System 2.0, logo, Tourvisor/API contract, price arithmetic, lead transport/field mapping, Metrika/goals and repository isolation. Keep technical refactor and mass SEO expansion deferred. Do not invent benefits, operating hours or legal/payment terms. Latest owner clarification 2026-09-08: prioritize the product/site roadmap; CSS/JS growth is allowed for real visual, usability and functional improvement. Hard 12KB/zero-growth or mandatory per-packet savings is not the goal. Replace superseded owners/rules/handlers in the same packet; no stacked duplicate layers. Continue beyond one PR in the same invocation while a safe next step and time remain.

scoped_refactor_authorization.scope: Search3 product presentation and source ownership; useful visual/functional growth allowed, replace duplicates in current owners, preserve protected business contracts. Follow active_roadmap; broad technical refactor remains deferred.

required: exact artifact build and focused presentation/source checks
verification_policy.restore: ready_for_review event on each affected workflow; production approval still required
verification_policy.live: Do not publish or repeat the live journey for each behavior-preserving technical pass. Publish at an accumulated checkpoint, for a relevant behavior/layout change, or on owner request. When publishing, inspect only the changed area; a complete search/flight/lead journey is required only if the affected behavior needs it.

working_code_draft: one exact artifact build (including PHP/path/presentation/isolation checks)
ci_execution.artifact_reuse: Keep the successful working-PR source artifact after release fast-forward and documentation checkpoints; do not rebuild or redeploy docs.
ci_execution.restoration: Non-draft PRs restore all applicable workflows on ready_for_review.

batch_execution.working_draft: Keep one coherent useful product packet plus related duplicate removal in a release-based draft; one final push/CI cycle per completed packet.
batch_execution.local_checks: Build generated assets once after the source batch and measure the eight served files. Run the narrow existing equivalence or affected-behavior check. Do not repeat the artifact workflow's full check set locally.
batch_execution.ci: Retain the two existing mandatory working-source jobs, successful on the final source SHA. Do not disable security, owner validators, protected paths or preview isolation. Reuse the successful artifact.
batch_execution.publication: A checked technical batch may remain unpublished in release; no deploy-control PR, artifact download or browser session is required merely because another source PR completed. Reuse the final checked source artifact at the next justified publication.
batch_execution.budget_rule: Manual-check timebox is not acceptance. Record incomplete evidence as deferred; fix/revert confirmed regressions and continue independent safe product work.
batch_execution.reduction_priority: Prioritize current Search3 product/site roadmap and visible/functional benefit. Useful CSS/JS growth is authorized; remove duplicate layers in the affected component. No separate micro-saving PR/deploy/browser cycles.
batch_execution.reporting: Lead with user-visible benefit; disclose new packet CSS/JS growth/deletion and initial/complete load delta. Do not count code movement or prior work as new savings; do not repeat historical totals as progress.
batch_execution.production: Production approval, protected contracts, ready_for_review restoration and actual deployment guards remain unchanged. Owner explicitly resumed hourly Search3 development.

whole_layer_retirement.scope: Large reversible Search3 presentation-layer retirement with compact preservation of needed rules/handlers and repair of concrete isolated-preview breakage.

product_development_policy.duplicate_layers: Replace superseded implementation in the same packet; no stacked override skins or duplicate handlers.
